seoTitle: QR Code Generator - Create Custom QR Codes
metaDescription: Free online QR Code Generator. Instantly create scannable QR codes for website URLs, text, Wi-Fi networks, and contact cards. Download in high resolution.
intro: Need to share a website link on a physical flyer or a restaurant menu? Our free QR Code Generator creates high-resolution, scannable 2D barcodes instantly.
whatIs: The QR Code Generator is a digital graphics tool that encodes large amounts of data (like URLs, VCards, or plain text) into a two-dimensional matrix barcode (Quick Response code) that can be scanned by any smartphone camera.
howToUse: Select the type of data you want to encode (URL, Text, Wi-Fi).
Enter the required information into the fields.
The QR code image will generate and update in real-time.
Click 'Download' to save the high-quality image for printing.
howItWorks: The tool uses the Reed-Solomon error correction algorithm to translate your data into binary, then maps that binary into the black-and-white grid pattern of a QR code. It adds standard positioning squares in three corners so cameras know how to orient the scan.
workedExample: You enter the URL 'https://example.com'. The tool encodes the string, calculates error correction data, and paints the data matrix onto an HTML canvas, producing a scannable square image instantly.
resultInterpretation: The resulting image can be printed on physical media or displayed on screens. When scanned by a phone camera, the phone will automatically decode the matrix and prompt the user to open the link or read the text.
useCases: Marketing: Placing a QR code on a business card or billboard that directs users to a promotional landing page.
Hospitality: Generating a QR code for restaurant tables so customers can view a digital PDF menu.
Networking: Creating a QR code that automatically logs guests into your home or office Wi-Fi network.
tipsAndLimitations: The more data you put into a QR code, the denser and more complex the pixel grid becomes. Very complex grids must be printed larger to remain scannable.
Use URL shorteners before generating a QR code to keep the grid simple and highly scannable.

faq.question: Do QR codes expire?
faq.answer: The QR codes generated by our tool are 'Static'. They contain the raw data itself. They never expire and will work forever. (Dynamic QR codes, which rely on a redirect server, can expire, but we do not use those).

faq.question: What is Error Correction?
faq.answer: QR codes have built-in redundancy. Depending on the level chosen, up to 30% of the QR code image can be damaged, covered up, or ripped off, and a phone will still be able to scan and read it perfectly.

cta: Create your free QR Code now!
disclaimer: Static QR codes encode data directly and cannot be edited once generated. Always test scan your downloaded code before sending it to a commercial printer.
